text:
Joel Eriksson Ek is the Wild's two-way center, and his season has two kinds of luck running in opposite directions. Matt Boldy said this week he doesn't get the credit he deserves, and our numbers partly agree.

His own shots are unlucky. He has 8 goals on 12.4 expected, and he keeps getting to the net, and goals tend to follow chances. But the Wild have scored 8.9 more goals than their chances deserve while he is on the ice, which is padding his 23 points.

He has been effective lately, with 11 points in his last ten games against about 7.8 expected, including four in a win over Nashville, while his minutes dropped by more than two a night. Minnesota gets 58% of the expected goals at five on five with him out there, and Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 98th percentile last season. We project about 65 points as the Wild ride an 11-0-3 run.
headline: Eriksson Ek is due, and also lucky
